messages:
Nina L.: Hey team — unpacked my desk kit but the external webcam (Logi HD) is missing; box had dock and keyboard only. Also getting "certificate signed by unknown authority" when trying to join redwood-wifi. Anyone know the quickest fix? Order RDW-8112
Marco (buddy): Welcome Nina! :wave: Ping @Felix - Facilities for hardware. For wifi, @Dana (IT) is our mac/linux person.
Felix - Facilities: Hi Nina — can you DM the courier tracking and the packing slip photo? If webcam missing we'll issue a replacement; loaner webcams at reception if you need one now.
Nina L.: Sent tracking: https://track.example/abc987 — delivery says "Front desk" at 08:45. Packing slip attached in DM.
Dana (IT): For the cert error, what does the browser show? If it's "NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID" try reinstalling corp CA via:
`````
sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain ~/Downloads/redwood_ca.crt
`````
If that errors post the output and I'll open a ticket.
Nina L.: Error from helper: "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority" then "permission denied" when trying to write to system keychain. I'm on macOS 13.5.1. Remote session would be great.
Dana (IT): Opening ticket IT-2026-4899 and assigning to mac-support. I'll PM for a remote session; meanwhile grab a loaner webcam from reception (they have USB ones).
Felix - Facilities: Replacement order OR-2026-399 placed, ETA tomorrow morning. Reception will hold a loaner till then.
hr-bot: Welcome Nina! Your onboarding schedule is updated. Reminder: buddy check-in at 3pm.
Nina L.: Thanks all — grabbing loaner and will join the remote. I'll update this thread after the session.
